intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Snorkeling Safari at North Malé Atoll House Reef
experiences.description: Begin your honeymoon with a guided private snorkeling safari directly from your overwater bungalow jetty at a luxury resort in North Malé Atoll. Since your flight arrives late on Day 1, this experience is perfectly scheduled for Day 2 morning when you are refreshed. Explore vibrant coral gardens, sea turtles, and reef sharks with a personal marine biologist guide. Many top resorts here — such as those on Kuredu or Huvafen Fushi — have house reefs steps from your villa, eliminating transfer time entirely.

experiences.name: Sunset Champagne Cruise on a Traditional Dhoni
experiences.description: Drift across the Indian Ocean on a private traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, sipping champagne as the sun melts into the horizon. This quintessential romantic experience is offered by most luxury resorts in South Malé Atoll, including those near Maafushi and Guraidhoo, making it easily accessible without long speedboat transfers. Dolphins frequently join the journey, and the golden light creates unforgettable honeymoon memories. Ideal from Day 3 onward once you have settled in.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience at Ithaa or Similar
experiences.description: Indulge in an extraordinary dining experience at one of the world's most iconic underwater restaurants, located at Conrad Maldives Rangali Island or a comparable venue in Ari Atoll. Surrounded by a 270-degree panoramic acrylic tunnel, you dine on Maldivian-inspired gourmet cuisine while reef fish and rays glide past. Book this for mid-trip (around Day 6–7) as a romantic highlight. Staying at a resort within Ari Atoll eliminates lengthy inter-atoll travel, keeping this within easy reach.

experiences.name: Manta Ray Snorkeling at Hanifaru Bay UNESCO Biosphere Reserve
experiences.description: Hanifaru Bay in Baa Atoll is one of the world's premier manta ray feeding aggregation sites and a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. Join a small-group guided snorkel tour to swim alongside dozens of manta rays and whale sharks in their natural habitat — a truly once-in-a-lifetime experience for snorkeling enthusiasts. To avoid the long speedboat journey from distant atolls, choose a resort based in Baa Atoll such as those near Dharavandhoo, which offer direct 10-minute transfers to the bay. Best experienced mid-trip on a calm day.

experiences.name: Couples Overwater Spa Ritual with Maldivian Coconut Scrub
experiences.description: Unwind together in an overwater spa pavilion with open-ocean views, experiencing a traditional Maldivian wellness ritual using locally sourced coconut, frangipani, and sea salt. This 90-minute couples treatment includes a full-body scrub, hot stone massage, and floral bath drawn over the lagoon. Available at luxury resorts throughout North Malé Atoll — particularly those on Velaa Private Island or Gili Lankanfushi — which are conveniently close to Velana International Airport, making it ideal for Day 2 or as a relaxing wind-down experience in the final days of your 13-day stay.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll (Gaafu / Velaa area), Maldives

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Complete immigration and customs. Take a budget speedboat or public ferry transfer to Ari Atoll (book in advance for savings). Check in to Ari Atoll Boutique Stay, freshen up, and explore the property and nearby beach shoreline.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the beach at sunset for a romantic first evening. Watch the sky turn golden over the Indian Ocean. Settle in and relax after the long journey.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at the airport - local short eats like samosas and fish rolls from airport cafeteria (budget-friendly, under $8)
meals.dinner: Dinner at the guesthouse or a nearby local eatery - try Maldivian mas riha (fish curry) with roshi flatbread (~$8-12 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book your speedboat or ferry transfer in advance to save money. Public ferries are significantly cheaper than private transfers. Keep your first evening light as travel fatigue will be real after a long-haul flight.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for a stunning Indian Ocean sunrise from the beach. After breakfast, rent basic snorkel gear from the guesthouse or a local dive shop and explore the house reef just off the boutique stay's beach - Ari Atoll is famous for incredible marine biodiversity.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget group snorkeling trip to a nearby coral garden or sandbank (book through the guesthouse for group rates ~$15-20 per person). Look out for reef sharks, manta rays, and colorful parrotfish. Return and relax on the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beachside walk as the stars emerge - Ari Atoll has minimal light pollution making for spectacular stargazing. Sit on the beach with a drink and enjoy the tranquility.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast - fresh tropical fruits, tuna paste (mas huni) with flatbread, and tea (~$5-8 included or low cost)
meals.lunch: Packed lunch from guesthouse to take on snorkeling trip - tuna sandwiches and fresh coconut (~$4-6)
meals.dinner: Local island restaurant dinner - grilled fish with steamed rice and vegetable curry (~$10-14 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Apply reef-safe sunscreen only to protect the coral ecosystem. Bring an underwater camera or rent a waterproof phone case to capture marine life memories.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at the house reef during high tide when visibility is best. Look for sea turtles which are commonly spotted in Ari Atoll. Take photos and enjoy the calm morning waters before tourist crowds arrive.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby local inhabited island by public ferry or dhoni boat to experience authentic Maldivian village life. Walk through the narrow sandy streets, visit the local mosque, and browse small shops for affordable souvenirs like woven mats and lacquerware.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset dhoni cruise - book a budget group sunset cruise (~$20-25 per person) to watch dolphins playing in the wake of the boat as the sun sets. A truly romantic and magical experience.

meals.breakfast: Mas huni and roshi at guesthouse - traditional Maldivian breakfast with black tea (~$5-7)
meals.lunch: Eat at a local teahouse (sai hotta) on the inhabited island - hedhikaa short eats platter with tea (~$4-6)
meals.dinner: BBQ night at the guesthouse or beach - freshly grilled tuna, lobster if budget allows, with salad (~$12-16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: When visiting local islands, dress modestly out of respect for Islamic culture - cover shoulders and knees. Bikinis are only permitted on designated tourist beaches.

day_by_day.morning: Manta ray snorkeling excursion - Ari Atoll is one of the world's best spots for manta ray encounters. Book a budget group tour (~$30-40 per person) to manta cleaning stations. This is a bucket-list experience for snorkelers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the boutique stay and spend the afternoon relaxing on the beach. Build sandcastles, read a book under a palm tree, or simply float in the crystal-clear lagoon. Enjoy the romantic seclusion.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a simple private beach picnic setup with the guesthouse (often available at low cost or free). Lay out a mat, bring some local snacks and drinks, and enjoy the moonlit beach together.

meals.breakfast: Fresh fruit platter and eggs at guesthouse (~$6-8)
meals.lunch: Packed lunch on the manta ray boat - tuna wraps, water, and fresh fruit (~$5-7)
meals.dinner: Cook or order a simple Maldivian curry at the guesthouse - garudhiya (tuna broth) with rice and lime (~$8-10 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The manta ray season in Ari Atoll runs year-round but is most reliable March through November. Never touch or chase manta rays - maintain a respectful distance to preserve the experience for everyone.

day_by_day.morning: Whale shark snorkeling adventure - South Ari Atoll is globally renowned as a year-round whale shark hotspot. Book a budget group whale shark tour (~$35-50 per person). Swimming alongside the world's largest fish is an unforgettable romantic memory.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a sandbank (faru) - arrange a budget sandbank picnic trip through the guesthouse. Enjoy the surreal experience of standing on a tiny strip of white sand surrounded entirely by turquoise ocean. Perfect for romantic photos.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at the guesthouse. Watch a movie together or play board games. Share stories about the incredible marine encounters of the day.

meals.breakfast: Pancakes with honey and tropical fruit at guesthouse (~$5-8)
meals.lunch: Picnic on the sandbank - fresh coconut, tuna sandwiches, and tropical fruits brought from the guesthouse (~$6-8)
meals.dinner: Splurge slightly for a special dinner - freshly caught grilled lobster or jumbo prawns at a local restaurant (~$18-25 per person, a worthwhile treat)

day_by_day.notes: Whale shark sightings are never 100% guaranteed as they are wild animals. Tour operators will refund or reschedule if no whale sharks are found. Bring motion sickness tablets if you are sensitive to boat travel.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and leisure morning - sleep in and enjoy a slow breakfast. Spend time in the lagoon swimming and snorkeling at your own pace. No guided tours today - just free exploration and relaxation.
day_by_day.afternoon: Learn to kayak or paddleboard in the calm lagoon - rent equipment from the guesthouse (~$8-12 per hour). Paddle out to explore nearby coral patches and enjoy the warm afternoon sun. A fun and romantic activity for couples.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a local cultural show if available on the island - traditional bodu beru drumming and dancing performances are sometimes organized for tourists (~$10-15 per person or free). Experience authentic Maldivian culture.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely breakfast at guesthouse - eggs your way, toast, fresh juice (~$6-9)
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the guesthouse cafe - tuna salad wrap and fresh coconut water (~$7-10)
meals.dinner: Local restaurant - chicken or fish curry with steamed rice, dhal, and papadum (~$9-13 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Today is intentionally relaxed to prevent burnout mid-trip. The Maldives is best enjoyed slowly - resist the urge to fill every moment with activities.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning fishing trip - join a traditional Maldivian hand-line fishing excursion at sunrise (~$20-30 per person). Fish using traditional methods alongside local fishermen. Catch your own breakfast - a truly authentic experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: If fish were caught, arrange with the guesthouse to cook your catch for lunch. Spend the afternoon exploring the local island on foot or by bicycle (rent bikes ~$5-8 per day). Visit the island's harbor and watch fishing boats return.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic sunset on the opposite side of the island from the main beach - find a quiet spot to watch the sun dip below the horizon together. Collect shells along the shoreline.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before fishing - tea, roshi, and banana (~$3-5)
meals.lunch: Cook your fresh-caught fish at the guesthouse - grilled with lemon, garlic butter, and rice (~$5-8 for ingredients)
meals.dinner: Guesthouse set dinner - three-course meal of soup, main fish dish, and dessert (~$12-15 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The fishing trip is a midpoint highlight - it connects you with the heart of Maldivian culture as fishing is the lifeblood of these islands. Bring sunscreen and a hat for the open-water morning.

day_by_day.morning: Snorkeling at a different reef site - ask the guesthouse to recommend a lesser-visited reef in the area. Explore independently with rented gear for a more personal and peaceful underwater experience away from group tours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Island hopping by local ferry to explore two or three nearby local islands. Each Maldivian island has its own character. Shop for local handicrafts, chat with residents, and photograph the colorful painted houses and mosques.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private candlelit beach dinner setup with the guesthouse (budget option ~$30-50 for setup, cook your own simple meal or order from guesthouse kitchen). A wonderfully romantic honeymoon-style evening without resort prices.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast - mas huni, roshi, and fresh papaya (~$5-7)
meals.lunch: Eat at a local teahouse during island hopping - short eats sampler and sweet tea (~$4-6)
meals.dinner: Private beach candlelit dinner - grilled fish, salad, rice, and a shared dessert with sparkling juice (~$25-35 for two)

day_by_day.notes: The private beach dinner can be arranged 24 hours in advance with most guesthouses for a fraction of resort prices. This is a wonderful way to create a luxury romantic experience on a budget.

day_by_day.morning: Snorkeling and marine biology session - many local dive shops offer free or low-cost marine identification talks. Learn to identify the fish and coral species you have been seeing all week. Then snorkel with new knowledge at the house reef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax and pamper day - book a budget massage at a local spa or guesthouse wellness service (~$25-40 per person for 60 minutes). Many local guesthouses offer basic massage services at a fraction of resort prices.
day_by_day.evening: Photography golden hour - take your best sunset photos of the week. Walk to the best vantage points on the island for silhouette shots against the orange sky. Create lasting honeymoon memories.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie bowl with tropical fruits at guesthouse (~$6-8)
meals.lunch: Light lunch - fresh tuna salad with lime dressing and coconut water (~$7-9)
meals.dinner: Splurge night two - order a special seafood platter for two at a local restaurant (~$20-28 for two)

day_by_day.notes: Budget massages in local guesthouses are often just as good as resort spas at 20-30% of the price. Ask the guesthouse to recommend a trusted local therapist.

day_by_day.morning: Coral restoration snorkeling tour - some local operators in Ari Atoll offer eco-tours where you can participate in coral planting activities (~$20-30 per person). A meaningful and educational experience that gives back to the reef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Free afternoon at the beach - swim, sunbathe, read, and simply soak in the paradise surroundings. Take a long nap in a hammock. This is what the Maldives is all about.
day_by_day.evening: Night snorkeling experience - arrange a guided night snorkel with the guesthouse or a local operator (~$20-25 per person). See bioluminescent plankton, sleeping fish, hunting octopuses, and nocturnal reef creatures. Magical and romantic.

meals.breakfast: Full guesthouse breakfast - eggs, toast, fruit, and tea (~$6-9)
meals.lunch: Beach picnic - pack your own from the guesthouse kitchen: sandwiches, fruit, and cold drinks (~$5-7)
meals.dinner: Early dinner before night snorkel - simple rice and curry at guesthouse (~$8-11 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Night snorkeling is one of the most unique and romantic experiences in the Maldives. Bioluminescent plankton creates a magical blue glow in the water when disturbed - like swimming through stars.

day_by_day.morning: Final major snorkeling expedition - revisit your favorite reef site from the trip for one last extended snorkeling session. Take mental snapshots and say goodbye to your underwater friends - the turtles, sharks, and mantas.
day_by_day.afternoon: Souvenir shopping and packing - visit local shops for affordable Maldivian souvenirs: hand-painted lacquerware, woven palm leaf items, locally made jewelry, and dried fish products. Budget $20-40 for meaningful keepsakes.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell romantic beach walk. Collect a small jar of sand from the beach as a free and meaningful memento. Watch the last full sunset of your Maldives trip together.

meals.breakfast: Special farewell breakfast - order something new from the menu you haven't tried yet (~$6-9)
meals.lunch: Local teahouse lunch - full Maldivian rice table with multiple curries (~$8-12 per person)
meals.dinner: Celebratory farewell dinner at the best local restaurant in the area - order the catch of the day (~$15-20 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Start packing tonight to avoid morning stress. Keep all receipts and check your budget tracking. Maldivian lacquerware boxes make beautiful and authentic gifts that are unique to these islands.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise swim in the Indian Ocean - wake before dawn for one last magical experience. Float in the warm water as the sky turns pink and orange. A perfect romantic closing chapter to your Maldives adventure.
day_by_day.afternoon: Checkout from Ari Atoll Boutique Stay. Store luggage with the guesthouse if needed. Take a final walk around the island, thank the staff, and take last photos of your home for the past 12 days.
day_by_day.evening: Transfer back to Velana International Airport via speedboat or public ferry. Arrive with plenty of time before departure. Browse duty-free for any last-minute gifts.

meals.breakfast: Last Maldivian breakfast - mas huni and roshi with sweet tea, savoring every bite (~$5-7)
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the guesthouse or packed for the journey - tuna wrap and fruit (~$5-7)
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or cafe dinner before departure - international options available (~$12-18 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book your return transfer in advance. Public ferries are cheapest but have fixed schedules - confirm timing with your guesthouse. Allow at least 3-4 hours before your flight for the transfer and airport procedures.

day_by_day.morning: Departure day - if your flight departs today, enjoy any remaining airport time browsing duty-free shops. Maldivian tuna products, local honey, and handicrafts make excellent last-minute purchases. Board your flight home with incredible memories.
day_by_day.afternoon: In-flight - rest, review your photos, and start planning your next adventure. The Maldives will have left an indelible mark on your hearts.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive home with a collection of unforgettable memories - whale shark encounters, manta ray dances, bioluminescent night swims, romantic candlelit beach dinners, and the most impossibly blue water you have ever seen.

meals.breakfast: Airport breakfast or early in-flight meal (~$8-12 or included with flight)
meals.lunch: In-flight meal (included with LH flight)
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or home-cooked meal upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Total estimated budget for 13 days (excluding flights and accommodation): approximately $400-600 per person covering meals, local transport, snorkeling tours, and activities. Ari Atoll guesthouse stays are 60-80% cheaper than resort islands while offering the same stunning natural environment.

trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00 at Velana International Airport (Malé)
day_by_day.afternoon: Airport arrival, immigration, and baggage collection. Transfer to Ari Atoll Boutique Stay via speedboat or domestic flight (~45–60 min). Check in, freshen up, and take a leisurely walk along the beach to get oriented with the resort surroundings.
day_by_day.evening: Welcome dinner at the resort's main restaurant. Enjoy a romantic table by the water's edge as the sun sets over the Indian Ocean. Toast to the beginning of your Maldives honeymoon.

meals.breakfast: N/A (in-flight or airport)
meals.lunch: Light snack or meal at Velana Airport café before transfer
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at Ari Atoll Boutique Stay's beachfront restaurant — try the fresh grilled fish and local coconut curry (mid-range set menu)

day_by_day.notes: Request an early check-in if possible when booking. Confirm speedboat transfer schedule in advance. Keep essentials accessible in carry-on for the water transfer.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early and enjoy a sunrise stroll along the beach. After breakfast, head to the resort's house reef for a relaxed introductory snorkel session — spot colorful reef fish, coral gardens, and perhaps a sea turtle near the shallows.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Snorkeling Safari at North Malé Atoll House Reef — begin your honeymoon adventure with a guided private snorkeling safari directly from your overwater bungalow jetty. Your guide will lead you through vibrant coral formations and introduce you to the underwater world of the Maldives.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset Champagne Cruise on a Traditional Dhoni — drift across the glowing Indian Ocean on a private traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, sipping chilled champagne while watching the sun melt into the horizon. A quintessential romantic Maldives experience.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort's main dining area — fresh tropical fruits, pastries, eggs to order, and fresh juices
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch at the resort's beach shack — grilled sandwiches, fresh salads, and coconut water
meals.dinner: Dinner back at the resort's restaurant after the cruise — request a candlelit table on the deck overlooking the lagoon

day_by_day.notes: Book the Private Snorkeling Safari and Sunset Dhoni Cruise through the resort concierge upon arrival. Both experiences are best enjoyed back-to-back on the same day for a full romantic day on the water.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast. Spend the morning relaxing on your private deck or beach — read, sunbathe, or simply listen to the waves. Optional: try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) or kayaking available through the resort's water sports center.
day_by_day.afternoon: Couples Overwater Spa Ritual with Maldivian Coconut Scrub — unwind together in an overwater spa pavilion with panoramic open-ocean views. Experience a traditional Maldivian coconut scrub followed by a soothing couples massage. This 90-minute ritual uses locally sourced ingredients including coconut, frangipani, and sea salt.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the sandbank at low tide as the sky turns pink and purple. Enjoy a quiet dinner at the resort's specialty restaurant or order an in-villa dining experience on your private terrace.

meals.breakfast: À la carte breakfast on your private deck — eggs Benedict, fresh tropical fruit platter, and local Maldivian tea
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the spa lounge post-treatment — herbal teas, fresh fruit, and light wraps
meals.dinner: In-villa romantic dinner on your private terrace — pre-arranged with the resort, featuring a set 3-course menu with seafood and a bottle of wine

day_by_day.notes: Book the spa ritual at least 2 days in advance as couples slots fill quickly. Opt for the late afternoon slot (around 3:00–4:30 PM) to transition smoothly into the evening.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at a nearby reef patch accessible by the resort's snorkeling guide boat. Look out for reef sharks, rays, and moray eels in the early morning calm waters when visibility is at its best.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the local Maldivian culture with a visit to a nearby inhabited island (arranged through the resort). Walk through the village, visit the local mosque, browse handicraft stalls, and interact with friendly locals. A great way to experience authentic Maldivian life beyond the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy sundowners at the resort's overwater bar. Watch the stars emerge over the atoll — the Maldives offers some of the most spectacular stargazing in the world due to minimal light pollution.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort — load up before the snorkel session
meals.lunch: Local tea house on the inhabited island — try mas huni (tuna and coconut salad) with roshi flatbread, a traditional Maldivian lunch staple
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant — grilled lobster or catch-of-the-day with a side of steamed rice and tropical salad

day_by_day.notes: The inhabited island excursion is culturally important — dress modestly (cover shoulders and knees) out of respect for local customs. Bring small cash for local purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience at Ithaa or a similar iconic underwater restaurant (coordinate transfer with the resort). Enjoy a spectacular brunch or early lunch surrounded by the living ocean — coral, fish, and rays glide past the panoramic glass walls as you dine.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Ari Atoll and spend the afternoon at leisure. Lounge by the infinity pool, enjoy tropical cocktails, and take a nap in a hammock strung between palm trees on the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset yoga session on the beach (offered by most boutique resorts in the Maldives). Follow with a quiet dinner at the resort, reflecting on the magical underwater dining experience from earlier in the day.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at the resort before the transfer — fresh fruit, yogurt, and coffee
meals.lunch: The Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience IS the main meal — a multi-course set menu featuring Maldivian and international cuisine paired with mocktails or wine
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort beach grill — fresh grilled prawns, vegetable skewers, and fried rice

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant (Ithaa at Conrad Maldives or equivalent) requires advance booking — ideally 4–6 weeks before travel. Confirm transfer logistics and timing with the resort concierge. This is a splurge-worthy experience even on a mid-range budget.

day_by_day.morning: Full day excursion to Hanifaru Bay UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in Baa Atoll for Manta Ray Snorkeling. Depart early by speedboat (approximately 1.5–2 hours). Arrive at Hanifaru Bay and snorkel alongside massive, graceful manta rays in their natural feeding aggregation — a truly once-in-a-lifetime experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue snorkeling at Hanifaru Bay or nearby reef spots in Baa Atoll as part of the guided excursion. Your guide will point out whale sharks (if in season), reef sharks, and abundant marine life in this UNESCO-protected zone.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ari Atoll by speedboat. Enjoy a well-deserved rest and a soothing hot shower. Dine at the resort and share stories from the day's incredible manta ray encounter.

meals.breakfast: Early hearty buffet breakfast at the resort before departure
meals.lunch: Packed lunch provided by the resort or excursion operator — sandwiches, fruit, snacks, and water on the boat
meals.dinner: Celebratory dinner at the resort's specialty restaurant — treat yourselves to a seafood platter for two with a glass of wine

day_by_day.notes: Manta ray aggregations at Hanifaru Bay are most frequent between May and November, but March can still offer sightings. Confirm with the resort concierge about current conditions. The excursion must be booked through a licensed operator — the resort can arrange this. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, motion sickness tablets if needed, and an underwater camera.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery day after the Baa Atoll excursion. Sleep in and enjoy a slow breakfast. Spend the morning floating in the crystal-clear lagoon directly off your bungalow or beach — the shallow, warm water of Ari Atoll is perfect for effortless relaxation.
day_by_day.afternoon: Try a new water activity — opt for a beginner scuba diving discovery session offered by the resort's PADI dive center. Even without certification, you can experience the underwater world with an instructor in shallow, safe waters. Alternatively, enjoy a glass-bottom boat tour over the reef.
day_by_day.evening: Private beach bonfire dinner — arrange with the resort for a romantic bonfire setup on a secluded stretch of beach with lanterns, cushions, and a private chef serving a curated menu. A magical mid-trip romantic highlight.

meals.breakfast: Lazy breakfast in bed — order room service featuring pancakes, fresh juice, and tropical fruit
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch — Caesar salad, fish tacos, and fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Private beach bonfire dinner — pre-arranged 3-course seafood menu with sparkling wine under the stars

day_by_day.notes: The private beach bonfire dinner should be arranged 2–3 days in advance with the resort. This is a mid-range splurge but well worth it for the honeymoon experience. Confirm availability and any weather contingency plans.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling at a different reef spot around Ari Atoll — Ari Atoll is famous for whale shark sightings, especially around Rangali and Maamigili areas. Join a guided whale shark snorkeling excursion through the resort (typically a half-day trip by boat).
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from the whale shark excursion. Spend the afternoon browsing the resort's boutique for Maldivian souvenirs and local crafts. Enjoy an afternoon at the resort's spa — choose individual treatments such as a deep tissue massage or a hydrating facial.
day_by_day.evening: Casual evening at the resort's overwater bar — enjoy signature cocktails, live acoustic music (if available), and tapas-style sharing plates as the stars fill the sky.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast before the excursion
meals.lunch: Light snack on the boat or quick lunch at the resort upon return — fresh fruit smoothies and a wrap
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant — try the Maldivian-themed tasting menu featuring local flavors like smoked fish, breadfruit curry, and coconut-based desserts

day_by_day.notes: Whale shark sightings in Ari Atoll are among the most reliable in the world year-round, with March being a good month. The excursion is typically 3–4 hours. Bring your GoPro or underwater camera for unforgettable footage.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise kayaking around the resort's lagoon — paddle through the calm, glassy water as the morning light turns the ocean gold. Spot reef fish through the crystal-clear water from your kayak. A peaceful and intimate morning activity for couples.
day_by_day.afternoon: Cooking class at the resort — learn to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes such as garudhiya (tuna broth soup), mas huni, and coconut sambal with a local chef. A fun, interactive, and culturally enriching experience.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the meal you prepared together at a private table set up by the resort. Pair your Maldivian feast with fresh lime juice or a local ginger tea. Spend the evening strolling along the moonlit beach.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before kayaking — yogurt parfait, granola, and fresh juice
meals.lunch: Post-cooking class lunch — enjoy the dishes you prepared with the chef in a relaxed setting
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's restaurant — keep it light after the big cooking class lunch; opt for a fresh salad, grilled fish, and a shared dessert

day_by_day.notes: Cooking classes are a wonderful way to connect with Maldivian culture and bring skills home as a lasting honeymoon memory. Book through the resort's activities desk. Classes are typically 2–3 hours long.

day_by_day.morning: Full relaxation morning — no planned activities. Sleep in, order room service breakfast, and spend the morning on your private deck watching the ocean. Read, nap, or simply hold hands and enjoy the silence of paradise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Sandbank picnic excursion — the resort arranges a private transfer to a secluded uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the ocean. Enjoy a curated picnic basket with champagne, fresh fruit, cheese, and snacks while sitting on a strip of pure white sand surrounded by turquoise water in every direction.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a couples' sunset yoga or meditation session on the beach. Wind down with a gentle dinner and an early night to recharge.

meals.breakfast: Room service breakfast — avocado toast, fresh fruit, and coffee delivered to your private deck
meals.lunch: Sandbank picnic — champagne, artisan cheeses, fresh tropical fruits, sandwiches, and local snacks
meals.dinner: Light dinner at the resort's beachfront restaurant — grilled vegetable platter, fresh fish, and a shared tiramisu for dessert

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank picnic excursion is one of the most iconic and romantic Maldives experiences. Arrange it through the resort concierge at least 2 days in advance. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and a waterproof bag for your belongings.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling adventure — revisit your favorite reef spot or ask the resort guide to take you somewhere new. Spend a leisurely morning underwater, soaking up the beauty of the Maldives reef one more time. Take photos and cherish the moment.
day_by_day.afternoon: Afternoon at leisure — try a new resort activity such as windsurfing, banana boat riding, or simply lounging in the overwater hammock attached to your bungalow. Alternatively, visit the resort's library or games room for a quiet afternoon together.
day_by_day.evening: Special anniversary/honeymoon dinner arranged by the resort — most boutique resorts offer a complimentary or discounted romantic dinner setup for honeymooners. Enjoy a candlelit dinner on the beach with flower petals, lanterns, and a personalized menu.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort — fuel up for the morning snorkel
meals.lunch: Casual lunch at the resort's beach café — fish burger, sweet potato fries, and a fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Romantic honeymoon dinner on the beach — 4-course set menu with lobster, beef tenderloin, and a chocolate lava cake; paired with a bottle of sparkling wine

day_by_day.notes: Inform the resort at check-in that you are on your honeymoon — many boutique resorts in the Maldives offer complimentary romantic touches such as flower baths, room decorations, or special dining setups. This is the perfect evening to use that perk.

day_by_day.morning: Last full day in the Maldives — make the most of it. Wake up early for a final sunrise over the lagoon. Take a long walk on the beach, collect shells, and photograph every detail of your paradise home for the past 12 days.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in one last spa treatment — choose a relaxing facial, foot massage, or aromatherapy session to pamper yourselves before the journey home. Pack your bags in the late afternoon and leave them with the resort's bell service.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the resort's best restaurant. Order your favorite dishes from the trip and raise a toast to an unforgettable honeymoon. Watch the stars one final time from the beach or your deck.

meals.breakfast: Special farewell breakfast — order the full works: eggs, pastries, tropical fruits, fresh juice, and coffee
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's poolside bar — avoid heavy meals before the potential boat/flight transfer the next morning
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the resort's signature restaurant — order à la carte and choose your personal highlights from the trip's menu

day_by_day.notes: Settle your resort bill this evening to avoid a rushed checkout tomorrow. Confirm your transfer time and flight details with the concierge. Pack reef-safe sunscreen and any souvenirs securely.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — enjoy one last breakfast at the resort. Take a slow walk to the water's edge and dip your feet in the Indian Ocean one last time. Check out of your room and wait in the resort's comfortable lounge or beach area.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transfer from Ari Atoll to Velana International Airport (Malé) via speedboat or domestic flight. Allow ample time for the transfer and airport check-in. Browse duty-free shops in Malé airport for last-minute Maldivian souvenirs — local honey, dried fish snacks, or handcrafted lacquerware make great gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Departure flight from Velana International Airport. Reflect on 13 magical days in the Maldives — the manta rays, the bioluminescent nights, the champagne sunsets, and the warmth of the Indian Ocean. Carry those memories home.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — savor every bite of that tropical buffet
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or café in Malé — light meal before the flight
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport dining depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Speedboat transfers from Ari Atoll to Malé typically take 45–90 minutes depending on sea conditions. Domestic flights take about 20–25 minutes. Add buffer time and confirm the transfer schedule with the resort the night before. Keep travel documents, passports, and valuables in your carry-on during the water transfer.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Snorkeling Safari at North Malé Atoll House Reef
experiences.description: Begin your honeymoon with a guided private snorkeling safari directly from your overwater bungalow jetty at a luxury resort in North Malé Atoll. Since your flight arrives late on Day 1, this experience is perfectly scheduled for Day 2 morning when you are refreshed. Explore vibrant coral gardens, sea turtles, and reef sharks with a personal marine biologist guide. Many top resorts here — such as those on Kuredu or Huvafen Fushi — have house reefs steps from your villa, eliminating transfer time entirely.

experiences.name: Sunset Champagne Cruise on a Traditional Dhoni
experiences.description: Drift across the Indian Ocean on a private traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, sipping champagne as the sun melts into the horizon. This quintessential romantic experience is offered by most luxury resorts in South Malé Atoll, including those near Maafushi and Guraidhoo, making it easily accessible without long speedboat transfers. Dolphins frequently join the journey, and the golden light creates unforgettable honeymoon memories. Ideal from Day 3 onward once you have settled in.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience at Ithaa or Similar
experiences.description: Indulge in an extraordinary dining experience at one of the world's most iconic underwater restaurants, located at Conrad Maldives Rangali Island or a comparable venue in Ari Atoll. Surrounded by a 270-degree panoramic acrylic tunnel, you dine on Maldivian-inspired gourmet cuisine while reef fish and rays glide past. Book this for mid-trip (around Day 6–7) as a romantic highlight. Staying at a resort within Ari Atoll eliminates lengthy inter-atoll travel, keeping this within easy reach.

experiences.name: Manta Ray Snorkeling at Hanifaru Bay UNESCO Biosphere Reserve
experiences.description: Hanifaru Bay in Baa Atoll is one of the world's premier manta ray feeding aggregation sites and a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. Join a small-group guided snorkel tour to swim alongside dozens of manta rays and whale sharks in their natural habitat — a truly once-in-a-lifetime experience for snorkeling enthusiasts. To avoid the long speedboat journey from distant atolls, choose a resort based in Baa Atoll such as those near Dharavandhoo, which offer direct 10-minute transfers to the bay. Best experienced mid-trip on a calm day.

experiences.name: Couples Overwater Spa Ritual with Maldivian Coconut Scrub
experiences.description: Unwind together in an overwater spa pavilion with open-ocean views, experiencing a traditional Maldivian wellness ritual using locally sourced coconut, frangipani, and sea salt. This 90-minute couples treatment includes a full-body scrub, hot stone massage, and floral bath drawn over the lagoon. Available at luxury resorts throughout North Malé Atoll — particularly those on Velaa Private Island or Gili Lankanfushi — which are conveniently close to Velana International Airport, making it ideal for Day 2 or as a relaxing wind-down experience in the final days of your 13-day stay.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll (Gaafu / Velaa area), Maldives

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Meet your private luxury transfer coordinator at the VIP lounge. Enjoy complimentary refreshments while paperwork is processed. Board a private seaplane or luxury speedboat transfer to Ari Atoll Boutique Stay. Check in, receive a traditional Maldivian welcome with fresh coconut water and flower garlands. Settle into your overwater villa and explore the property at leisure.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic private welcome dinner on your villa's overwater deck, arranged by the resort. Savor a curated 4-course meal featuring freshly caught Maldivian seafood — grilled lobster, tuna tartare, and tropical fruit desserts — paired with a bottle of chilled Champagne as the sun dips below the Indian Ocean horizon.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight or airport)
meals.lunch: Light bites and refreshments at the Velana International Airport VIP lounge or on transfer
meals.dinner: Private overwater welcome dinner at your villa — curated 4-course Maldivian seafood menu with Champagne, arranged by the resort's concierge

day_by_day.notes: Inform the resort in advance about your arrival time so the welcome setup and villa are ready. Request early villa access if possible. Confirm seaplane vs. speedboat transfer based on weather and availability — seaplane transfers typically operate until sunset.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up to your first full Maldivian sunrise from your overwater villa deck. Enjoy a leisurely in-villa breakfast delivered by private butler. Afterward, embark on the Private Snorkeling Safari at the Ari Atoll House Reef — a guided experience directly from your overwater bungalow. Explore vibrant coral gardens, encounter reef sharks, sea turtles, and tropical fish with a dedicated marine biologist guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the villa for a relaxing post-snorkel lunch. Spend the afternoon at leisure — lounge on your villa's sun deck, take a dip in your private plunge pool, or explore the resort's infinity pool. Optional: visit the resort's dive center to plan upcoming underwater adventures and get briefed on the week's marine life highlights.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the resort's signature overwater restaurant for a romantic dinner. Indulge in a tasting menu featuring Maldivian-inspired cuisine — smoked reef fish, coconut curry, and pandan-infused desserts. Pair with a curated wine selection recommended by the sommelier. End the night stargazing from your villa deck with a nightcap.

meals.breakfast: In-villa private butler breakfast — tropical fruit platter, freshly baked pastries, eggs your way, fresh juices, and Maldivian roshi flatbread
meals.lunch: Casual beachside or in-villa lunch — grilled barracuda, prawn salad, fresh coconut, and tropical smoothies
meals.dinner: Signature overwater restaurant tasting menu — 5-course Maldivian-fusion cuisine with sommelier-paired wines

day_by_day.notes: The house reef snorkeling safari is best done in the morning when visibility and marine activity are at their peak. Bring reef-safe sunscreen. The resort's marine biologist can tailor the snorkeling route based on recent sightings.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the morning with a couples' yoga session on a private sandbank or your villa's deck, led by the resort's wellness instructor. Breathe in the ocean air and set intentions for your honeymoon together. Follow with a nourishing breakfast at the resort's main restaurant with panoramic lagoon views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in the Couples Overwater Spa Ritual with Maldivian Coconut Scrub. Spend approximately 2–3 hours in a luxurious overwater spa pavilion with open-ocean views. Experience a traditional Maldivian coconut and pandanus scrub, followed by a couples' deep-tissue massage using locally sourced oils. Conclude with a floral bath and herbal tea ceremony.
day_by_day.evening: Embark on the Sunset Champagne Cruise on a Traditional Dhoni. Board a beautifully decorated private Maldivian dhoni boat and drift across the turquoise Indian Ocean as the sky transforms into shades of gold and crimson. Sip premium Champagne, enjoy canapés, and watch for dolphins playing in the boat's wake. Return to the resort for a quiet dinner.

meals.breakfast: Main restaurant breakfast with panoramic lagoon views — live cooking station with omelets, Maldivian fish curry, fresh tropical fruits, and artisan breads
meals.lunch: Light spa-friendly lunch served at the spa or villa — mezze platter, fresh juices, and light salads to complement the spa experience
meals.dinner: Intimate beachfront dinner at the resort's beach grill — wood-fired catch of the day, grilled vegetables, and a shared dessert platter

day_by_day.notes: Book the spa ritual and dhoni cruise at least 24 hours in advance through your butler. The sunset cruise timing should align with the local sunset time (approximately 18:15–18:30 in March). Request dolphin-watching as part of the dhoni cruise route.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a leisurely in-villa breakfast followed by a guided snorkeling excursion to one of Ari Atoll's most celebrated dive sites — the Maaya Thila or Fish Head (Mushimasmingili Thila). These UNESCO-protected sites are famous for schools of reef sharks, Napoleon wrasse, and vibrant coral formations. A private boat and guide will accompany you.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby uninhabited sandbank for a private picnic lunch. Your butler will have arranged a beautifully laid table on the white sand with chilled Champagne, fresh seafood, and tropical fruits. Spend the afternoon swimming in the crystal-clear shallows, collecting shells, and simply being present in paradise.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and freshen up. Dine at the resort's wine cellar or private dining cave (if available) for a truly exclusive experience. Enjoy a 6-course degustation menu with rare wine pairings selected by the head sommelier. Toast to your honeymoon with a special dessert prepared by the pastry chef.

meals.breakfast: In-villa butler breakfast — Maldivian mas huni (tuna and coconut), freshly squeezed juices, pastries, and barista-crafted coffee
meals.lunch: Private sandbank picnic — chilled Champagne, fresh lobster, sashimi, tropical fruit, and artisan cheeses
meals.dinner: Private wine cellar or exclusive dining experience — 6-course degustation menu with rare wine pairings

day_by_day.notes: Maaya Thila and Fish Head are also world-class dive sites if either of you holds a diving certification — the resort's PADI dive center can arrange guided dives as an upgrade. Sandbank picnics require advance booking through your butler.

day_by_day.morning: Take the morning slowly — sleep in, enjoy breakfast in bed delivered by your butler, and spend time on your villa's private deck watching the ocean. Optional: take a stand-up paddleboard (SUP) session around the lagoon, guided by a resort instructor. The calm morning waters of Ari Atoll are perfect for beginners and experienced paddlers alike.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a private guided snorkeling tour to the South Ari Atoll Marine Protected Area, famous for whale shark sightings year-round. This is one of the most thrilling wildlife encounters in the Maldives — swimming alongside the world's largest fish in their natural habitat. Your marine guide will ensure a responsible and unforgettable experience.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic overwater dinner at the resort's premium restaurant, with your table set directly above the lagoon. Opt for the chef's special catch of the day prepared in a Maldivian style — coconut-braised snapper, tuna carpaccio, and a decadent chocolate fondant to finish. Sip on a curated cocktail from the bar's signature honeymoon menu.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast in bed — croissants, smoked salmon, tropical fruit bowl, freshly squeezed juices, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: On-boat lunch during the whale shark excursion — freshly prepared wraps, tropical fruits, energy bars, and cold beverages
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant — chef's tasting menu with Maldivian-inspired dishes and signature honeymoon cocktails

day_by_day.notes: Whale shark encounters are highly likely in South Ari Atoll throughout March. All encounters follow strict guidelines — no touching, maintain distance, and use reef-safe products. The excursion typically takes 3–4 hours including boat transfer.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to pure relaxation and romance. Have your butler set up a private floating breakfast in your villa's plunge pool or lagoon — a quintessential Maldivian luxury experience. Afterward, take a leisurely stroll along the resort's private beach, hand in hand, as the morning light dances on the water.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in a private Maldivian cooking class hosted by the resort's executive chef. Learn to prepare traditional dishes such as garudhiya (fish broth), mas riha (tuna curry), and bondibai (rice pudding). This intimate culinary experience offers insight into Maldivian culture and ingredients, and you'll enjoy your creations for lunch.
day_by_day.evening: As the sun sets, head to the resort's sky bar or rooftop lounge for sundowner cocktails with panoramic 360-degree views of the atoll. Later, enjoy a private beach barbecue dinner — freshly grilled seafood, mezze, and desserts under a canopy of stars, with soft ambient music playing in the background.

meals.breakfast: Floating breakfast in the villa plunge pool — tropical fruits, pastries, yogurt parfait, fresh juices, and Champagne
meals.lunch: Enjoy the dishes prepared during your Maldivian cooking class — garudhiya, mas riha, and bondibai
meals.dinner: Private beach barbecue — grilled lobster, prawns, reef fish, mezze platters, and a bespoke dessert under the stars

day_by_day.notes: The floating breakfast setup requires advance notice to your butler (the evening before). The cooking class is typically 2–3 hours and is a wonderful cultural immersion activity. Confirm beach barbecue details and any dietary preferences in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of your honeymoon — celebrate with a sunrise snorkeling session at the house reef before the day heats up. The early morning light creates magical underwater visibility. Spot sleeping reef sharks, octopuses, and moray eels before they retreat for the day. Return for a hearty breakfast at the main restaurant.
day_by_day.afternoon: Board a resort speedboat for a day trip to a nearby local island (such as Mahibadhoo or Feridhoo in Ari Atoll). Explore the authentic Maldivian village life, visit the local mosque, browse artisan shops for handcrafted souvenirs, and interact with friendly locals. Gain a deeper appreciation of Maldivian culture beyond the resort bubble.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy the Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience at a partner venue (Ithaa Undersea Restaurant or similar, accessible via resort arrangement). Dine surrounded by a 270-degree panoramic acrylic tunnel beneath the Indian Ocean — an awe-inspiring and utterly romantic setting for a special mid-honeymoon celebration dinner.

meals.breakfast: Main restaurant breakfast — extensive buffet with Maldivian, Asian, and Western options; freshly made omelets, tropical fruits, and premium teas
meals.lunch: Local island experience — try authentic Maldivian street food such as short eats (hedhikaa), samosas, and fresh coconut at a local café
meals.dinner: Underwater restaurant dining experience — multi-course gourmet menu with panoramic undersea views and curated wine pairings

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant (Ithaa or similar) requires reservations well in advance — ideally at the time of booking your trip. The resort concierge can arrange transfers and reservations. Local island visits should respect cultural norms — dress modestly (cover shoulders and knees) when outside resort areas.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a full morning of leisure and indulgence. Sleep in and take a slow morning. Order a lavish in-villa breakfast and spend time reading, journaling your honeymoon memories, or simply watching the ocean from your deck. Optional: book a private photography session with the resort's photographer to capture stunning honeymoon portraits at the villa and on the sandbank.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on a private sunset fishing excursion Maldivian-style (big eye tuna and snapper fishing on a traditional dhoni). Your guide will teach you traditional hand-line fishing techniques. Any catch can be brought back to the resort's kitchen and prepared as your dinner — a truly farm-to-table (or ocean-to-table) experience.
day_by_day.evening: Dine on your freshly caught fish, prepared by the resort's chef in your preferred style — grilled, ceviche, or Maldivian curry. Enjoy this bespoke dinner either at the main restaurant or set up privately on your villa deck. End the evening with a couples' stargazing session guided by the resort's astronomer (if available) or simply lie back and marvel at the Milky Way.

meals.breakfast: Luxurious in-villa breakfast — eggs Benedict, smoked salmon, tropical fruit platter, freshly baked breads, and barista coffee
meals.lunch: Resort beach club — fresh salads, grilled sandwiches, coconut-based dishes, and tropical mocktails by the pool
meals.dinner: Ocean-to-table dinner — your freshly caught fish prepared by the resort chef, served with seasonal sides and a fine wine selection

day_by_day.notes: Arrange the photography session through the resort in advance. The fishing excursion is typically 2–3 hours in the late afternoon. Confirm with the kitchen in advance that your catch will be prepared for dinner — the chef may suggest the best preparation method based on what you catch.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the day to one of the Maldives' most spectacular wildlife experiences — the Manta Ray Snorkeling at Hanifaru Bay UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in Baa Atoll. Depart early by seaplane or speedboat (approximately 30–45 minutes). Hanifaru Bay is one of the world's premier manta ray feeding aggregation sites, where dozens to hundreds of mantas gather to feed on plankton. Your expert marine guide will lead the snorkeling session.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the Hanifaru Bay experience, enjoy a leisurely lunch on the boat or at a nearby luxury resort in Baa Atoll before your return transfer. Take time to reflect on the extraordinary morning and browse your underwater photos captured by the guide. Return to Ari Atoll Boutique Stay by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: After the day's adventure, unwind with a private couples' massage at the overwater spa. Follow with a quiet, romantic dinner at the resort — choose from the à la carte menu featuring the freshest seafood and Maldivian specialties. Enjoy a glass of wine on your villa deck as the stars emerge.

meals.breakfast: Light early breakfast before departure — fresh fruits, energy bars, yogurt, and coffee to prepare for the excursion
meals.lunch: On-boat or nearby resort lunch — fresh sandwiches, seafood wraps, tropical fruits, and cold beverages
meals.dinner: Resort à la carte dinner — grilled reef fish, lobster bisque, and a shared chocolate dessert platter with fine wine

day_by_day.notes: Hanifaru Bay manta ray aggregations are most spectacular from May to November, but March can still offer sightings. The UNESCO designation means strict snorkeling rules apply — no fins, no touching, and limited group sizes. Book this excursion well in advance as spots are limited. The full day trip (including transfers) can take 6–8 hours.

day_by_day.morning: After yesterday's adventure, take a truly restful morning. Enjoy a floating breakfast, then spend time in your private plunge pool. Optional: attend a resort-led coral planting experience — a meaningful and eco-conscious activity where you plant coral fragments on the house reef and receive a certificate of your contribution to marine conservation.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's water sports offerings at leisure — try kayaking through the lagoon, windsurfing, or a thrilling jet ski ride around the atoll. Alternatively, simply relax at the resort's infinity pool with a cocktail in hand, soaking up the Maldivian sun. Visit the resort's boutique to browse curated Maldivian crafts and luxury keepsakes.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate your 10th day in paradise with a specially arranged Overwater Dinner for Two — a private table set on a jetty or floating platform above the lagoon, decorated with candles, rose petals, and lanterns. A personal chef will prepare a bespoke 5-course menu tailored to your preferences, with a live acoustic musician serenading you throughout the evening.

meals.breakfast: Floating breakfast in the lagoon — tropical fruits, pastries, yogurt, fresh juices, and Champagne
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch at the resort — gourmet burgers, fresh salads, and tropical smoothies
meals.dinner: Private overwater jetty dinner — bespoke 5-course chef's menu with live acoustic music and Champagne

day_by_day.notes: The coral planting experience is a wonderful way to give back to the ocean. Arrange the private overwater dinner through your butler at least 2 days in advance — specify any dietary requirements, preferred cuisine style, and music preferences. This is an ideal moment for a special gesture such as a surprise gift or toast.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a guided sunrise kayaking tour through the atoll's calm lagoon waters. Watch the sky transform from deep indigo to brilliant gold as the sun rises over the Indian Ocean. Your guide will point out sleeping marine life just beneath the surface. Return to the resort for a relaxed breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a full afternoon spa journey — book the resort's signature half-day wellness package. Begin with a steam and sauna session, followed by a Maldivian herbal poultice massage, a hydrating facial using local ingredients, and a reflexology treatment. Emerge completely rejuvenated and glowing.
day_by_day.evening: Spend the evening exploring the resort's bar scene — start with pre-dinner cocktails at the overwater bar, where the bartender can craft personalized honeymoon cocktails using local ingredients like coconut, pandan, and fresh tropical fruits. Dine at the resort's premium restaurant one final time this week, savoring a menu of your favorite dishes from the trip so far.

meals.breakfast: Post-kayaking breakfast at the main restaurant — hearty options including eggs, Maldivian fish curry, tropical fruits, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Light spa lunch — detox juices, salads, and light bites served at the spa or villa
meals.dinner: Resort premium restaurant — personalized menu of your honeymoon favorites, with a special dessert surprise from the chef

day_by_day.notes: The sunrise kayaking tour requires an early start (approximately 05:45–06:00). The half-day spa package should be booked 24 hours in advance. Ask the bartender to create a signature cocktail named after your honeymoon — a fun and personal keepsake memory.

day_by_day.morning: On your penultimate full day, revisit your favorite spot from the trip — whether that's the house reef, a sandbank, or simply your villa deck. Take a final snorkeling session to say goodbye to the underwater world of Ari Atoll. Capture final underwater photographs and videos to treasure forever.
day_by_day.afternoon: Dedicate the afternoon to meaningful memory-making. Visit the resort's gift shop for curated Maldivian keepsakes — hand-painted lacquerware, woven mats, and locally made jewelry. Alternatively, participate in a private batik or lacquerware painting workshop offered by the resort as a cultural activity. Create a piece of art to bring home from your honeymoon.
day_by_day.evening: Grand finale dinner — request the resort's most exclusive dining experience for your last full evening. This could be a private beach dinner under a canopy of stars, a rooftop dinner with 360-degree atoll views, or a candlelit dinner on a private sandbank reached by boat. Dress up, pop a bottle of vintage Champagne, and toast to your love and this extraordinary journey.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — your favorite items from the week, specially requested through your butler
meals.lunch: Casual beach club lunch — fresh seafood platters, tropical cocktails, and light bites
meals.dinner: Grand finale private dinner — bespoke setting of your choice, gourmet menu curated with the chef, vintage Champagne

day_by_day.notes: Discuss the grand finale dinner location and menu with your butler at least 2 days in advance. This is the night to pull out all the stops — consider surprising your partner with a special arrangement such as a message in a bottle, rose petal decoration, or a custom cake. Begin packing non-essentials this evening.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for one final sunrise from your villa deck — take it all in. Enjoy a leisurely last breakfast at the main restaurant or in-villa. Take a final walk along the beach, collect a handful of white sand as a memento, and take photographs of your overwater villa. Check out formalities begin — your butler will assist with luggage.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, enjoy any remaining resort amenities — a final dip in the infinity pool, a last cocktail at the overwater bar, or simply sit on the jetty and watch the ocean one more time. Board your private speedboat or seaplane transfer back to Velana International Airport. Relive your favorite memories during the scenic transfer.
day_by_day.evening: Depart the Maldives with hearts full of memories. If your flight departs in the evening, spend time at the Velana International Airport's premium lounge.
